title: Earth from space: colouring sheet
subject: Geography
source: Written for geography/y1 lesson 5 (Earth from space colouring sheet and a satellite image of the UK (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 5. Colour the land green and the sea blue. Find where we live.

picture.find: The Blue Marble photograph of Earth from Apollo 17
picture.alt: A photograph of the Earth from space

blocks.caption: Outline from Natural Earth (public domain); modern coastlines and borders.

questions.q: What colour is the sea on a satellite image?
questions.model: Look at the picture. Find the big blue areas. Blue is the sea.

questions.q: Is there more land or more sea on Earth?
Core: Colour a picture of Earth: blue for sea, green for land, white for clouds.
questions.a: Sea blue, land green, clouds white
questions.model: Teacher shows it first: blue all round the edges, green for the land shapes, white swirls on top.

questions.q: Extend: Point to the UK on the satellite image.
questions.a: The UK is in the sea to the north-west of Europe

questions.q: Stretch: Where is the ice on Earth?
questions.a: At the North and South Poles

questions.q: A picture of Earth from space is called a:
Big question: what would you see if you looked down at the Earth from space?
questions.a: Blue sea, green and brown land, white clouds and ice
